title: Savoy Cardinals basketball preview 1978
text:
Savoy Cardinals

At Savoy, the Cardinals are going to have a difficult time matching the performance of last year's district 34-B champion team.

Coach Jimmy Parish is used to the feeling since the Cardinals have won seven consecutive district championships. This year is going to be a bit different, in fact the Cardinals will have difficulty putting together a winning season. The 2-11 record thus far this season is far from the 32-6 record of last year's champs.

With no returning lettermen, the Cardinals have a long season ahead, one that should build character.

Coach Parish is a graduate of Paris Junior College and East Texas State University and teaches History and P.E.

Coach Joe Dodson and the Savoy girls team have matched the boys stride for stride winning seven consecutive district 34-B championships.

The girls return only three lettermen from last year's team and the possibility of eight straight championships looks pretty slim.

The girls have a 1-6 record so far this year compared to last year's 36-3 team.

Coach Dodson has been at Savoy for several years and is somewhat of a tradition there. He is a graduate of North Texas State University and teaches P.E. and Drivers Education.
